selected_meaning: P_S = chance that a web check which finds a decisive answer confirms the service (confirmed vs contradicted; no-information checks excluded). It is not the chance that a phone call finds the service.

service_head.base_scorecard: candidate A expert prior scorecard (fit_prior/prior_a.py), no weight fitted

platt.contribution_rule: every term contribution is a x prior contribution; base = a x sum(intercepts) + c

existence_head: prior-only expert settings, not learned (decision; 47 DEV negatives, all 'unclear and searched')
selection_rule: ship the least-fitted of A < A_platt < B < B_platt < C unless a more-fitted one lowers grouped 5-fold OOF log loss by at least one paired cluster SE
public_note: Public DEV pairs: 28 confirmed, 3 contradicted. The score has no demonstrated ranking ability for public facilities (AUROC interval spans 0.5 widely).

band_thresholds.rule: LIKELY: p >= t_L, P_L and P_E >= 0.7, T >= 2. UNLIKELY: p <= t_U, or C = 2 with T <= 1 (the c2 term). Otherwise CALL_FIRST when T >= 2, else NO_SERVICE_TEXT.

eligibility.rule: common/eligibility.py eligible_facilities: exclude_review records are not scored

conformal_note: Pseudo-queries are (service, state) groups of DEV pairs, median size 2 to 3; a random order reaches nearly the same coverage, so k carries little information about live queries.
calibration_note: bins on DEV OOF P_S for decided pairs and on the shipped P_S for undecided pairs
